summary.text: Tacit is a project for private finance across Bitcoin and Ethereum.
People can shield, swap, send, earn, and borrow through a tacit1 ID.
Its pages describe a DeFi pool and a separate Pay pool with different functions.
The Tacit chain is presented as a place to hold TAC privately and pay others.
The project says the pools do not share on-chain assets; transfers between them use public withdrawal and shielding.
Payment proofs are made on the payer’s device and checked on Ethereum, according to Tacit.
Sending has a published 0.002 TAC fee; Tacit says most fees cover Ethereum gas.
DefiLlama reported about $192,688 of Tacit value locked on 24 November 2026.
Public sources reviewed do not establish a legal operator or a public administrator for every project component.

lines.quote: shield, swap, send, earn and borrow from one tacit1 ID

lines.text: Tacit says its DeFi pool can swap, farm, borrow, send and bridge to Bitcoin.
lines.quote: Swap, farm, borrow, send, bridge to Bitcoin

The main Etherscan address page returned HTTP 403 in this research environment; can its deployment and creator metadata be independently retrieved?

notes.what_it_does: Read the home page, build page, chain documentation, linked code repository, DefiLlama, Bankless, and Tacitscan. The report distinguishes Tacit’s DeFi pool, Pay pool, and payment chain.
notes.how_it_works: Project descriptions are statements, not independently proven technical guarantees. Bankless and Tacitscan observations are retained as claims.
notes.money: The TAC ERC-20 supply read from Ethereum is a current bridged ERC-20 reading, not a claim about all Bitcoin-side TAC issuance. No market-price row is included.
notes.people: Tacit’s linked X, GitHub, and Discord channels were identified. No legal operator or publicly named founder was established from the reviewed sources; ross.wei is kept as an account name only.
notes.on_chain: Ethereum RPC reads were made at block 26,487,251. The main Etherscan page was attempted but returned HTTP 403, so it supports no report line.
notes.history: No earlier results were supplied. Four dated claims and one tracker reading are included; the project’s current version history remains incomplete.
